title: Deflation map and the sum of inverses of the element orders in finite groups
summary: Let $G$ be a finite group. In this note, we construct an element $σ^G$ in the Burnside ring of $G$ over $\mathbb{Q}$, which gives a rational number $m(G)$ that is the sum of the inverses of the element orders in $G$, by using the deflation map ${\mathrm{Def}}^G_{G/N}$ induced by the $(G/N,G)$-biset $G/N$ for a normal subgroup $N$ of $G$. As a corollary to Theorem, we obtain another expression for the rank of the crossed Burnside ring $B^{\rm c}(G)$ of $G$ and the determinant of the Cartan matrix of $p$-local Mackey algebra of $G$ over a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with big enough.
